knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The extension duster reaches high surfaces from the floor. A chair, desk or bookcase is not a safe platform.
Dusting with the slats keeps dust moving with the slat rather than back into the grille.
A loaded pad spreads dust. Changing the pad keeps the wall clean.

practicalCriteria: Chooses the extension duster, flat mop with pad, or backpack vacuum for the surface, and sets the length so no stretching is needed.
Dusts a painted wall in vertical strokes from the upper edge down, shifts sideways, and changes the pad when it is loaded, with no visible streaks left.
Dusts a vent along the line of its slats and reports any vent that cannot be reached safely, without standing on furniture.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% pass mark, which for three questions means all three correct. Practical sign-off is separate and observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of one wall and one vent
stopWorkCriteria: Worker stands on a chair, desk or furniture to reach a high point
Dust pushed back into a vent against the slats
